title.narrative: National Information Platform for Food and Nutrition in Kenya (NIPFN)

description.narrative: National Information Platforms for Nutrition (NIPN) is an international initiative of the European Commission with support from the United Kingdom Department for International Development and the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation. Each country that participates in the initiative will be supported to create a platform to bring together and analyse existing information and data from all sectors to support the development of evidence-based policies and programmes to improve human nutrition.
